title: Plans
question: What have you written down so it can be replayed?

empty.title: No plan yet
empty.description: A plan describes a drill once so it can be replayed. Write the first one here, or from a terminal.

noHistory.title: The catalogue needs a database
noHistory.description: Plans live in the drill history database, and this deployment has none it can open.

newTitle: Pick the machine this plan drills
readOnly: This session can read the catalogue but not change it.
noProvider: No provider is configured, so there is nothing to write a plan against.

validation.valid: This document is a valid plan.
validation.invalid: This document is not a valid plan.
validation.name: Name
validation.normalizedHint: What the plan actually says once the defaults are filled in.

conflict.title: This plan changed while you were editing it
conflict.description: Someone saved a new version. Nothing you typed has been lost.

rename.title: A plan cannot be renamed in place
rename.description: Renaming means deleting this plan and creating another. Its past drills would keep their own name either way.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The plan is removed from the catalogue.
delete.keeps: Past drills keep their name and the exact document they ran. They lose only the link back to this plan.
